components.institution_label: Family and Medical Leave Act of 1993 (FMLA)
components.description: Federal FMLA: up to 12 workweeks of unpaid, job-protected leave in a 12-month period for birth, adoption or foster placement, a family member's or the employee's own serious health condition.
components.faculty_group_note: "eligible" employees; the parental leave policy refers to a faculty member's right to unpaid leave under the university's FMLA policy
components.eligible_parent_wording: to care for the employee's child after birth, or placement for adoption or foster care; employee's spouse ... serious health condition; employee's own serious health condition
components.duration_note: Policy page says 'up to 12 weeks'; statute: 'a total of 12 workweeks of leave during any 12-month period'. Paid leave may be substituted at the employee's or employer's option.
components.service_requirement: at least one year, and 1,250 hours over the previous 12 months (at least 50 employees within 75 miles)
components.dual_employee_rule: spouses employed by the same employer may be limited to an aggregate of 12 workweeks (29 U.S.C. 2612(f))
components.medical_certification_note: may be required to support leave for a serious health condition
components.notice: 30 days advance notice when the leave is foreseeable

notes: Reference date 2018-02-22. Governing documents: Faculty Parental Leave Policy (2018_00, effective 2002-01-01, capture 2017-09-11; its version note says the next capture 2018-10-30 has the same text) and the Policy on Faculty Leaves incl. Family Leave (2018_01, capture 2017-09-16). The VPF pages (2018_02, 2018_04) are summaries; 2018_02 supplies the pay wording 'regular salary and benefits'. missing=false: governing faculty leave policies covering tenure-stream faculty are saved.
Calendar: the documents speak of semesters but state no length; calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.

Parental leave: pay from the CMU Benefits Pool; 'not the intent ... to provide salary support when otherwise there would be none, e.g., during the summer'. Adoption limited to children of pre-school age; adopting a spouse's older children not necessarily covered. The three-year Provost-approval clause (from 2002-01-01) had lapsed by the reference date.

Birth parent chain: Faculty Parental Leave, 1 semester paid (c1), with FMLA 12 workweeks (c10) concurrent from its start, and the disability plan (c11, no length) concurrent with it when required; Faculty Family Leave (c2 full, or c3 partial, up to 1 year) is not linked to c1 by any text (no order or combination stated), so it is placed by no link.
Non-birth parent chain: Faculty Parental Leave, 1 semester paid (c1), with FMLA 12 workweeks (c10) concurrent from its start; Faculty Family Leave (c2/c3) unlinked, as for the birth parent.

Not components: university-supported professional leaves and leaves supported by outside funds (purpose professional development; a parent could not use them for a birth); Public Service Leaves (named in navigation only, not saved). Dependent tuition and child-care-center discount rules during leave are benefit continuation, not leave.

Cited but not saved: Carnegie Mellon Family and Medical Leave (Staff Handbook); the university's disability benefits plans (Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Benefits Programs); the university's benefits policy (benefits during family leave); Faculty Handbook (current issue); Application forms for faculty parental/family leave; Human Resources - Leaves of Absence page; college and school Appointment and Tenure Policies; Public Service Leaves policy; Paid Time Off policy (navigation link; staff).

The tenure-clock exclusion for family leave (c5) is capped in aggregate at two years; the general exclusion by agreement (c6) at two twelve-month years. Under the Appointment and Tenure Policy, exclusions totalling a year or more may extend the current term of appointment by a year (president, dean's recommendation, faculty agreement).
Family leave entitlement: coded guaranteed_on_request ('options to which eligible faculty are entitled') despite 'subject to approval by the provost'; flagged ambiguous.
